title: Wii Sports Resort
subtitle: Twelve sports share one island
summary: Wii Sports Resort is Nintendo's Wii sports collection set around Wuhu Island, expanding the approach of Wii Sports with twelve activities and the Wii MotionPlus accessory. A first arrival by parachute introduces the holiday setting before players move between contests on the water, in the air and on land. Mii characters keep the participants familiar, while the island gives the separate sports a shared home. Its bays, cliffs and buildings become landmarks that can be encountered from several different viewpoints as the collection moves between activities.
body: Wii Sports Resort is Nintendo's Wii sports collection set around Wuhu Island, expanding the approach of Wii Sports with twelve activities and the Wii MotionPlus accessory. A first arrival by parachute introduces the holiday setting before players move between contests on the water, in the air and on land. Mii characters keep the participants familiar, while the island gives the separate sports a shared home. Its bays, cliffs and buildings become landmarks that can be encountered from several different viewpoints as the collection moves between activities.

MotionPlus gives the Remote more detailed orientation tracking, allowing sports to respond to the angle as well as the broad direction of a movement. In table tennis, twisting during the swing changes the spin applied to the ball. Archery uses the Remote and Nunchuk together as bow and string, translating a recognisable physical pose into aiming and releasing an arrow. The activities introduce their own versions of the same promise: moving the controller deliberately should produce a difference that can be seen and understood in the resulting action.

Bowling and golf return beside new sports including swordplay and basketball, giving the collection both recognisable starting points and unfamiliar activities to learn. Several events support players taking turns with a shared controller, while others allow direct competition. Free flight over Wuhu Island offers another reason to notice the setting between contests. The collection makes the accessory's improved precision useful through these different forms of play, allowing a casual first attempt to develop into a repeated challenge once friends understand how a particular movement affects the result.
story_headings: A small rotation changes the result
A holiday can become a competition
